小米 MiMo 文本、视觉与语音模型: Xiaomi MiMo text, vision and speech models
填写小米 MiMo API Key。文本与语音模型使用不同的请求格式，应用会自动: Enter your Xiaomi MiMo API key. ReadFinch automatically uses the appropriate API for text and speech models.
自定义部署名称无法识别时，可在这里指定。图片指图片理解，可用于 OCR。: Set this for a custom deployment that cannot be classified. Image support means image understanding, including OCR.
通过 Chat Completions 合成语音，自动解码音频。: Generates speech through Chat Completions and decodes the audio automatically.
通过 Audio Speech 合成语音。兼容接口可使用自定义模型和音色。: Generates speech through Audio Speech. Compatible services can use custom models and voices.
可选，例如：语气温和、吐字清晰。音色与语速在「文本转语音」中配置。: Optional, e.g. a warm tone with clear articulation. Set voices and speed in Text to Speech.
不需要身份验证时，可将 API Key 留空。: Leave the API key blank if your service does not require authentication.
在「文本转语音」中选择音色并试听。: Choose and preview voices in Text to Speech.
选择语音合成提供商，音色列表会随之更新。使用在线音色时，朗读文字会发送给该提供商: Select a speech provider to see its voices. Text read with an online voice is sent to this provider.
语音服务不支持当前请求，请检查模型、音色与语音接口。: The speech service does not support this request. Check the model, voice and speech API.
语音服务没有返回有效的音频: The speech service did not return valid audio
此模型需要参考音频，请选择使用预置音色的 TTS 模型。: This model requires reference audio. Select a TTS model with built-in voices.
此模型需要音色描述，请先填写朗读风格。: This model requires a voice description. Enter a speaking style first.
语音合成模型只能用于在线朗读，请为文本功能选择其他提供商。: Speech models are used for online reading. Select another provider for text features.
输入文字，Enter 翻译，Shift+Enter 换行…: Type text, Enter to translate, Shift+Enter for a new line…
输入翻译可直接打开空白浮窗；选中文字后也可按指令快捷键处理。暂停自动划词时仍可使: Open a blank input window, or use an action shortcut on selected text. Shortcuts still work while automatic selection is paused.
